description:
How does a former software engineer turn a coffee shop idea into a $20M+ nationwide entertainment brand? On this episode of Forbes' The Pursuit, Ghost City Tours founder Tim Nealon breaks down how he scaled a coast-to-coast business spanning 56 locations and nearly 10 million guests. Learn how he disrupted traditional "circus-style" ghost tours by using authentic local history as a "Trojan Horse", survived intense hostility from local mom-and-pop operators, and built his own custom software platform named "Casper" to run operations and forecast demand. Plus, historic property developers explain why they recruited Ghost City Tours to revitalize local tourism in Little Rock.
